    As of March 27, 2026, Tiger Woods has been arrested or charged with driving under the influence (DUI)
    twice. The first arrest occurred in May 2017 for being asleep at the wheel, and the second occurred on March 27, 2026, following a single-vehicle rollover crash in Florida. 
    DUI and Driving Incidents Breakdown: 
    • May 2017 (Jupiter, FL): Arrested on suspicion of DUI after being found asleep in his car with the engine running. He later pleaded guilty to reckless driving and stated it was an unexpected reaction to prescription medications, not alcohol.
    • March 27, 2026 (Jupiter Island, FL): Arrested on charges of DUI, property damage, and refusal to submit to a lawful test after a single-vehicle rollover crash. 
    Other notable incidents included a 2009 crash with a fire hydrant and tree, and a serious 2021 rollover crash, but only the 2017 and 2026 incidents involved DUI charges.
